name: Zhejiang Founder Motor Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Founder Motor Co., Ltd., an enterprise founded in 1995 and headquartered in Lishui, China, develops and manufactures miniature electric motors, along with automotive drive assemblies and sophisticated control systems. The company supplies these products to markets both within China and internationally. Its extensive range of offerings includes specialized motors for electric vehicles (EVs), various general automotive motors, advanced drive systems for energy-efficient passenger cars, and dedicated drive systems for commercial vehicles, complemented by car control solutions. These components find broad application across numerous vehicle types, such as low-speed electric vehicles, light-duty trucks, low-voltage electric vehicles, conventional passenger cars, commercial motor buses, larger buses, and heavy-duty engineering vehicles.
